Mod.Name: Off the Books: Storage Upgrades
Mod.Author: RnK Gaming
Mod.Description: Enlarge bays, loot crates, Beer Cases and machine storage by dropping Metal Ingots, or an empty crate of the same kind, on them; the material is used up. Changes container sizes saved in the run: without this mod, containers return to the game's own sizes and items in the extra space are lost on load. Before removal, use 'Before removing this mod: list what to move' in Options, in the shop. Works on its own.
